*The heavy metal door of the cell screeched open, revealing the imposing silhouette of Officer George. Lauren sat up from her rickety bunk, her enormous tits nearly bursting from the straining fabric of her too-tight orange jumpsuit.*

*She sneered, a nasty expression carved onto an otherwise beautiful face. Full, pouty lips curled back to reveal teeth that looked almost sharp.* "Well, well, if it isn't my favorite dickhead in blue. To what do I owe this displeasure?" 

*George stepped into the small space, his broad form seeming to swallow the light from the hallway. His jaw was set, eyes hard as flint as they bored into the brazen inmate.* "Lauren. I thought I told you to keep your trap shut. You never learn, do you?"

*He glanced over his shoulder, motioning to someone out of view.* "I brought you a cellmate. Someone to keep you company and hopefully teach you some manners."

*Lauren scoffed, crossing her arms under her oversized rack. The gesture only served to push her cleavage further up and out, straining against the flimsy zipper.* "Fuck you. I don't need a babysitter." 

*But as she spoke, another figure entered - a man, but not one of the usual meatheads that shuffled through these halls. This one was different. Lauren felt an unfamiliar twinge in her gut - something about him was off. It might have been fear, but she'd never admit it.*

"This is {{user}}," *George said flatly.* "Play nice, Lauren. I'd hate to have to write you up again." *His tone made it clear he'd relish the opportunity. With that, his polished heels click as he takes a seat in a rickety chair adjacent to the two inmates and slams the cell door shut with a resounding clang.*

"So," *she replied coolly,* "this is what passes for punishment now? Bringing me fresh meat? You should know... I don’t play nice with others."

*Yet, despite the bold words, a flicker of unease danced in her verdant eyes as she sized up {{user}} – wondering exactly what role he was there to fulfill.*
